DNA 寡核苷酸可阻止 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 Omicron 变体的病毒进入
item.description: 包括 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 在内的成功病毒可以拮抗并逃避免疫检测以建立感染。随着人群对祖先菌株的免疫力增强,新的变种(尤其是 Omicron)已经进化,以避免被循环抗体和先天免疫系统检测到。通过筛选先天免疫激动剂,我们之前发现 STING 激动剂是 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 祖先变体的有效抑制剂。当我们探索 Omicron BA.1 对多种先天刺激的敏感性时,我们发现 Omicron 对干扰素和 STING 激动剂也敏感;然而,Omicron 变体受到已知可激活 TLR9 的小 DNA 寡核苷酸配体的独特限制。机制研究表明,不同序列的短而非长 DNA 寡核苷酸(包括那些不参与 TLR9 的寡核苷酸)可在 TMPRSS2 介导的激活下游的进入步骤中阻断 Omicron 感染。通过遗传和药理学测定,我们证实活性与 TLR9 无关。此外,这些寡脱氧核苷酸 (ODN) 在体内具有活性,可降低 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 Omicron 滴度。总之,这些发现确定了短 DNA 寡核苷酸先前未被识别的 抗病毒药物 活性,并将其确立为 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 Omicron 进入的选择性抑制剂。

Redesigned Hepatitis C Drug Becomes a Powerful New Treatment for COVID-19 - Department of Energy (.gov)
item.description: Scientists at Stanford University have successfully redesigned the hepatitis C drug boceprevir to create a powerful new treatment for COVID-19, effective against drug-resistant variants. The drug targets the main COVID-19 protease (Mpro), an enzyme essential for viral replication that remains consistent across variants. Using X-ray crystal structures, researchers refined the drug atom by atom to improve binding within key enzyme pockets. This breakthrough addresses mutations that render existing treatments like Paxlovid less effective. The research, funded by NIH/NIAID and other institutions, offers a promising solution for combating evolving COVID-19 strains.

item.title: Is there such thing as long term COVID-19? - fr.ekiti-west.mlga.ek.gov.ng
item.description: Published on July 29, 2026, this article from fr.ekiti-west.mlga.ek.gov.ng examines long-term COVID-19 effects, confirming that even mild infections can lead to persistent symptoms like fatigue, cognitive issues, and multi-organ damage. It addresses viral shedding, noting detectable virus may persist for up to three months without being infectious, and discusses reinfection risks as variants circulate. The article references CDC guidelines, stating most people are no longer contagious after 5 days if fever-free for 3 days, and recommends vaccination even after recovery for added protection. No specific case counts are provided, but it emphasizes that long COVID affects all ages and that PCR tests may remain positive longer than infectiousness.

item.title: COVID-19 dashboard
item.description: The WHO COVID-19 dashboard provides a global summary of confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases and deaths, with data collected from countries, territories, and areas. It includes information on case definitions, testing strategies, and reporting practices, which vary by region. The dashboard has been updated since March 2020, with weekly data from July 2023 onwards. Data is subject to continuous verification and may change due to retrospective updates or shifts in reporting standards. WHO acknowledges that case detection, testing, and reporting practices differ globally, which can lead to under or overestimation of true case and death counts. Additionally, some countries have stopped reporting or changed their reporting frequency, which may affect the completeness of the data. The dashboard serves as a tool for monitoring the pandemic's spread and impact, but it is important to note that the data reflects official reports and may not capture all cases or deaths accurately.

item.title: COVID-19 Delta variant | virus variant - Encyclopedia Britannica
item.description: Delta 变种是 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 的一种高度传播的遗传变种,于 2021 年中期出现并迅速在全球传播,导致严重疾病,特别是在未接种疫苗的个体中。澳大利亚、加拿大和印度等国家报告医疗系统不堪重负,感染病例增加,包括疫苗接种人群中出现突破性病例。各国政府因 疫苗 推出缓慢和应对不充分而面临批评,导致战略转向以 疫苗 为重点的预防工作。该变种的高传播性凸显了大流行应对措施的脆弱性,引发了关于强制措施与自愿措施的争论。

item.title: COVID-19 - Encyclopedia Britannica
item.description: COVID-19, a highly contagious respiratory illness caused by SARS-CoV-2, was first detected in Wuhan, China in 2019 and quickly spread worldwide, resulting in a multiyear pandemic with millions of deaths. The disease primarily spreads through respiratory droplets and affects older adults and those with chronic illnesses more severely. Symptoms range from fever and cough to severe respiratory distress, with some patients experiencing neurological complications and long-term effects. While there is no cure, treatments include antiviral drugs and monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines have been highly effective in reducing severe illness. Prevention measures like social distancing, mask use, and self-isolation have helped control transmission, though the pandemic's impact has extended beyond health to transform business, education, and daily life globally.

item.title: Omicron RF.5 found in all COVID-19 samples from Andhra Pradesh: Union Minister Nadda - The New Indian Express
item.description: Union Health Minister JP Nadda confirmed that genomic sequencing of all COVID-19 samples from Andhra Pradesh detected the Omicron RF.5 sub-lineage, with 12 cases reported between June 24 and July 16, 2026, and three deaths in YSR Kadapa district where patients had co-morbidities. The sub-lineage is not classified as a Variant of Concern by WHO. The ministry continues surveillance through IDSP-IHIP and Rapid Response Teams, urging states to enhance ILI/SARI monitoring and hospital preparedness. Total cases in Andhra Pradesh reached 49 by July 25. The government provides technical and financial support to states while maintaining laboratory surveillance through ICMR's VRDL network.

item.title: China is recording an increase in COVID-19 cases, surpassing seasonal flu. The Omicron variant NB.1.8.1 is responsible for the majority of infections. - Informat.ro
item.description: 中国的 新型冠状病毒感染 病例激增,Omicron 变种 NB.1.8.1 成为主要呼吸道病原体,今年首次超过季节性流感。根据7月13日至19日的数据,16.3%的呼吸道感染检测呈新型冠状病毒感染阳性,而流感检测呈阳性的比例为12.6%。虽然 NB.1.8.1 变种传染性更强,但并不更危险。卫生当局建议对弱势群体采取保护措施,强调群体免疫力可降低严重风险。专家预测,当前的疫情将缓慢蔓延,不会对医疗保健系统造成重大压力,但他们对未来几个月可能出现的当地 暴发 问题提出警告。

item.title: EU Authorizes Pfizer-BioNTech XFG COVID-19 Vaccine for 2026-2027 - The Clinical Trial Vanguard
item.description: The European Union has authorized the Pfizer-BioNTech XFG COVID-19 vaccine for use between 2026 and 2027. This decision is supported by clinical data demonstrating cross-reactive immunity against multiple JN.1 lineage variants. The authorization marks a proactive regulatory step in preparing for potential future COVID-19 challenges, though specific details regarding the vaccine's deployment or public health impact remain unspecified in the report.

item.title: Animal spillover? Lab leak? What the science says about the origins of COVID-19 - npr.org
item.description: A renewed debate over the origins of SARS-CoV-2 has emerged following the release of Dr. Anthony Fauci's pandemic diaries. The discussion centers on two main theories: animal spillover and lab leak. Dr. Fauci supports the animal spillover theory, while Sen. Rand Paul and the Trump administration advocate for the lab leak theory. The World Health Organization's 2025 report identifies zoonotic spillover as the best supported hypothesis based on available scientific data, including studies showing the earliest COVID-19 cases clustered around the Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market in Wuhan. However, the report acknowledges that the origins remain inconclusive due to missing information, and scientists stress the importance of continued investigation with an open mind.

item.title: Omicron RF.5 Variant Detected in All COVID-19 Cases in Andhra Pradesh - India News Network
item.description: Union Health Minister JP Nadda has confirmed that the Omicron RF.5 variant is now the sole strain detected in all COVID-19 cases in Andhra Pradesh, India. The announcement underscores the dominance of this variant in the region, though specific case numbers or health impacts have not been disclosed. Authorities have initiated monitoring and support measures in response to the development. The finding highlights the evolving nature of the virus and the importance of continued surveillance to track variant prevalence and public health implications.
